purpose: Recorded checks of all retained Lean contexts, including datasets awaiting human alignment review. Offline checks verify bindings and source inventories without rerunning Lean.
preservation_comparison: Elaborated expressions of all shared essential declarations agree modulo proof irrelevance, source-neutral binder/let metadata, generated matcher expansion, identity wrappers and source labels on existing data placeholders.
